about_section.description:
I'm not just a photographer; I'm a storyteller with a camera, capturing the essence of love in its most genuine form. My passion lies in preserving those fleeting moments of joy, laughter, and silent promises that make each wedding unique. With an international award-winning portfolio, I've mastered the art of blending traditional, candid, and cinematic styles to create visual narratives that resonate with the heart.

Picture a wedding day where every glance, every tear, and every smile is captured with such authenticity that it feels like reliving the moment each time you look at the photos. My approach is all about capturing the real emotions, ensuring that each couple's story is told beautifully and truthfully. It's not just about taking pictures; it's about crafting a timeless story that will be cherished for generations.

My philosophy is simple yet profound: every love story deserves to be remembered just as it was felt. Whether it's an intimate ceremony or a grand celebration, I bring emotion, artistry, and storytelling together to create a lasting impact. Photography is not just about images; it's about preserving the essence of a moment, a feeling, a story.

intro_section.name: Aamod P. Pisat
intro_section.tagline: Real, Modern, and Artistic - Three words that define who I am and how I tell your story.
intro_section.featured_content:
Where Every Frame Tells a Love Story.

At Aamod P. Pisat Photography, we specialise in capturing weddings with a perfect blend of candid charm and traditional elegance. Based in Mumbai and recognised internationally, our mission is to preserve your most heartfelt moments—raw, real, and timeless.

From pre-wedding shoots to destination weddings and baby showers, we turn emotions into cinematic memories. With over 10+  years of experience and a passion for storytelling, we ensure your celebration is remembered with grace, beauty, and authenticity.

Let us frame your love—beautifully and forever.

children.text: Crafting Love Stories. One Frame at a Time.
Every love story is unique—and we believe your wedding memories should be just as extraordinary. At
Aamod P. Pisat Photography
, we don’t just take photos—we create timeless visual stories that are as real, raw, and radiant as the moments themselves.

Based in Mumbai and capturing celebrations across India and beyond, we specialise in candid and traditional photography, cinematic & traditional videography, pre-wedding shoots, and destination weddings. With over
years of experience and the honour of being
International Award-winning
, our work reflects passion, creativity, and an eye for the moments that truly matter.

From the quiet emotions of a bride’s smile to the joy of a groom’s dance, we focus on capturing genuine emotions—not staged poses. Our team blends into your celebration like family, ensuring that every tear, laugh, and loving glance is preserved in its purest form.
Whether it’s the grand celebration of a wedding, the warmth of a baby shower, or the magic of a pre-wedding getaway, we deliver more than just images—we give you
memories that move you
With flexible payment options and a commitment to a stress-free experience, we’re here to make your big day beautifully unforgettable.
Your story deserves to be told with heart. Let us capture yours—with grace, depth, and timeless elegance.

My photography journey began quietly during my college days — sparked by curiosity, shaped by emotion, and driven by a deep love for storytelling. What started with a basic smartphone and candid moments among friends soon revealed my instinct for capturing genuine expressions and real emotions. Over time, this inner passion evolved into a clear purpose: creating timeless photographs and films that preserve memories, feelings, and stories for a lifetime.
I graduated from
Sardar Patel Institute of Technology (SPIT), University of Mumbai
, with a
Bachelor of Engineering in Information Technology

. Alongside my professional career, I began assisting some of the finest photographers in the industry. Working closely with them provided invaluable exposure, real-world experience, and a strong foundation that helped refine both my technical and creative skills. Armed with this learning, I took the leap to build something of my own — seamlessly balancing passion with responsibility by leveraging both my creative vision and technical expertise.
Today,
Aamod P. Pisat Photography

is a dedicated team that works relentlessly to bring your vision to life. We specialise in documenting stories of love, life, and emotion through thoughtfully crafted photographs and cinematic films. Based in
Mumbai
, we are proud to be a trusted choice for many couples seeking authenticity, elegance, and heartfelt storytelling.
Recognised among the
Top 200 Photographers in India
and honoured with an
International Award
, we continue to raise the bar — always striving to add new milestones, elevate our craft, and create work that truly stands the test of time.

We believe wedding films should feel like cinema—beautifully composed, thoughtfully edited, and emotionally resonant. Our films prioritise authentic moments over staged shots, natural audio over forced interviews. The result? A film that feels like stepping back into your day, experiencing every laugh, tear, and whispered promise all over again.

children.text: Dr Trushang & Vaishnavi — A Three-Day Celebration of Love
26 January 2023 | Mumbai

Some love stories feel like home. Dr Trushang and Vaishnavi’s wedding was exactly that—warm, joyful, and deeply emotional. Their three-day celebration in Mumbai was a beautiful journey of love, family, and togetherness, marking the beginning of a lifelong bond.
Day 1 – Sangeet: Joy in Every Beat

The festivities opened with a vibrant Sangeet filled with music, dance, and heartfelt performances. Surrounded by friends and family, Trushang and Vaishnavi shared quiet smiles and meaningful glances, radiating happiness. Every frame reflected celebration, pride, and pure joy.
Day 2 – Haldi: Intimate & Full of Colour

The Haldi ceremony was bright, playful, and filled with laughter. From candid moments to emotional blessings, the day felt effortless and genuine. An early morning couple shoot later captured the two in calm, natural light—simple, quiet moments that spoke volumes about their connection.
Day 3 – The Wedding: A Promise for Life

The wedding day was graceful and deeply moving. As rituals unfolded, emotions flowed naturally—tears of joy, heartfelt blessings, and smiles that said everything. Each moment, from the pheras to intimate family exchanges, was filled with meaning and love.
Our Storytelling Journey
At
Aamod P. Pisat Photography
, we focus on documenting emotions as they happen. With a seamless team and a shared vision, we captured every golden moment—candid, honest, and timeless.
A Story to Treasure Forever
More than a wedding, this was a celebration of love, respect, and genuine connection. Trushang and Vaishnavi, thank you for trusting us with your story. Your journey will always remain special to us.
Captured with love,
Aamod P. Pisat Photography

Dr. Trushang & Vaishnavi’s three-day destination wedding in Mumbai was a heartfelt celebration of love, emotions, and togetherness. From joyful Sangeet nights to emotional wedding rituals, Aamod P. Pisat Photography captured real moments, early morning couple shoots, and timeless memories filled with happiness and love.
Yuvraj Hatkar’s Upanayanam Ceremony — A Sacred Beginning

Some moments are timeless, rooted in tradition yet filled with heartfelt emotion. Yuvraj Hatkar’s Upanayanam (Thread) ceremony was one such day — a beautiful blend of spirituality, family bonds, and new beginnings. Our team at
Aamod P. Pisat Photography
was honored to document this meaningful milestone, capturing genuine emotions and cherished moments as they naturally unfolded.
A Ceremony of Tradition & Blessings

The Upanayanam ceremony marks a significant rite of passage, symbolizing a child’s initiation into spiritual learning and cultural values. As Yuvraj embraced this sacred moment, the atmosphere was calm, devotional, and filled with pride. Surrounded by his family, every ritual carried deep meaning, reflecting generations of faith and tradition.
Moments That Truly Matter

The day began with early morning rituals, gentle smiles, and quiet blessings from loved ones. As Yuvraj sat with the priest, dressed in traditional attire, emotions flowed effortlessly — from his parents’ proud glances to the warmth shared among family members. These were not posed moments, but real, heartfelt expressions that defined the essence of the ceremony.

When the sacred thread was bestowed upon Yuvraj, the room fell into a reverent silence. It was a powerful moment — one that symbolized responsibility, learning, and a new chapter in his life. Our focus remained on capturing these authentic emotions — the joy, the devotion, and the love that surrounded him.
A Celebration of Love & Connection

Beyond the rituals, the ceremony was filled with laughter, conversations, and togetherness. From intimate family portraits to candid interactions between cousins and elders, every frame reflected connection and warmth. Each photograph tells a story — not just of a ritual, but of relationships and memories that will be treasured forever.
A Memory Preserved Forever

Yuvraj’s Upanayanam was more than a ceremony — it was a celebration of heritage, family, and heartfelt blessings. We are grateful to have been part of this special day and to preserve these moments as timeless memories.
Thank you, Yuvraj and family, for trusting us with your story. Wishing you a life filled with wisdom, joy, and endless love.
With gratitude,
Aamod P. Pisat Photography

Yuvraj Hatkar’s Upanayanam ceremony was a beautiful celebration of tradition, love, and spiritual beginnings. From early morning rituals to the sacred thread investiture, Aamod P. Pisat Photography captured genuine emotions, happiness, and timeless moments that reflect the heart of this meaningful day.
Sushmita & Milind – A Love Story Framed by Nature
Pre-Wedding Shoot by Aamod P. Pisat Photography
Some love stories are loud. Some are quiet.
Sushmita and Milind’s love story
was calm, deep, and beautifully expressive—spoken through smiles, gentle gestures, and moments of togetherness.
Their pre-wedding shoot was planned as a journey through nature, emotions, and connection. From the open
beaches with endless skies
to the lush greenery of a
national park
, every location reflected their bond perfectly. It wasn’t just about photographs—it was about
capturing the real emotions
that naturally exist between two people in love.
Early Morning by the Beach – Where Romance Began
We began the shoot with
early morning beach scenes
, when the world feels quiet and the light is soft and magical. The sound of waves, the cool breeze, and the golden sunrise created a peaceful backdrop for Sushmita and Milind’s romantic moments.

Barefoot on the sand, walking hand in hand, sharing laughter, and exchanging kind words—these moments didn’t need direction. They simply happened. Our role was to observe, feel, and capture them as they unfolded naturally.
The beach gave us frames full of
love, happiness, and freedom
—where every smile felt genuine and every moment felt timeless.
Nature’s Embrace – Romance Amid Greenery

As the day progressed, we moved into the heart of nature—a national park filled with lush greenery, calm paths, and soothing light. This setting brought a different energy—more intimate, more grounded, and deeply emotional.

Surrounded by green landscapes, Sushmita and Milind looked completely at ease. Their connection felt effortless. A soft smile, a gentle touch, a moment of silence—these were the golden moments that made the shoot special.
The greenery became the perfect background for their
couple shoots
, highlighting not just their love, but also their comfort and trust in each other.
A Team That Captures More Than Images

Behind every beautiful frame is a dedicated team working quietly and passionately. Our photography team ensured that every emotion—big or small—was captured with care. From wide scenic shots to close emotional portraits, every image tells a story.
At
Aamod P. Pisat Photography

, we believe pre-wedding shoots are not about posing—it’s about letting couples be themselves. Sushmita and Milind trusted us with their story, and that trust allowed us to document their journey honestly and beautifully.
Moments That Will Last Forever
This pre-wedding shoot was a reminder that love doesn’t need grand expressions—it lives in small moments. In laughter shared, in eyes that understand, and in silence that feels comfortable.
Sushmita and Milind’s story is one of warmth, respect, and deep connection. We’re grateful to have captured these moments that will now live on forever through photographs.
Here’s to love, nature, and memories that grow more beautiful with time.
Captured with heart by Aamod P. Pisat Photography

Sushmita & Milind’s pre-wedding shoot was a beautiful blend of beachside romance and serene greenery. From early morning beach moments to intimate couple shoots in nature, Aamod P. Pisat Photography captured real emotions, love, happiness, and timeless memories.
